prompt: Explain and Examine Sidgwicks Utilitarian theory in points
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly explains Sidgwick’s utilitarianism (with key principles) and also includes an examination via common problems/criticisms, making it the closest match to “explain and examine.” Candidate 2 gives some Sidgwick-specific elements correctly (e.g., dualism of practical reason) but largely reframes the task into a Sidgwick-vs-Mill comparison and provides little genuine examination. Candidate 3 is mostly historical context and does not substantially explain or critique Sidgwick’s theory itself. Candidate 4 focuses on criticisms but provides little to no core explanation of the theory, so it only partially satisfies the prompt.
